negative_reviews.author: Adrien Massonnet
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) A mall restaurant where the service is supposed to be very rushed. There were inconsistencies in the service: we received our miso soup and gyoza before our drinks (cocktails), and the dishes arrived at different times (including a sushi/sashimi dish that could have waited). Avoid the gyoza and the miso soup, which were tasteless. The maki, nigiri, and sashimi were quite good. Overall, the value for money is rather poor for the basic quality.

(Original)
Restaurant de centre commercial où le service doit etre très expéditif. Des incohérences dans le service : nous avons eu notre soupe miso et des gyozas avant d avoir nos boissons (cocktails), les plats sont arrivés en décalé (dont un plat de sushi/sashimi qui pouvait attendre avant d etre servi). Evitez les gyozas et la soupe miso qui n ont pas de gouts. Les makis, nigiri, et sashimi etaient plutot bons. Un rapport qualité prix assez mauvais pour la qualité basique.

negative_reviews.author: Traveler
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) Just a heads-up: this restaurant also has another branch called Ramen Ramen. It's the same restaurant, just with a different name! The ramen, may God bless the food, was awful! The side dishes were delicious, and one of the main reasons we chose this place was because they confirmed that the food is halal! However, I wouldn't repeat the experience; the ramen was below average.

Just a heads-up: this restaurant also has another branch called Ramen Ramen. As far as I could tell, it's the same restaurant with a different name.

The side dishes were actually very tasty, and one of the main reasons we chose this place was because they confirmed that the food is halal.

Unfortunately, the ramen itself was very disappointing. It was below average in terms of flavor and didn't live up to expectations at all. I was expecting something much better.

Overall, I enjoyed the side dishes more than the main course, but I wouldn't come back for the ramen. It simply wasn't worth repeating the experience.
